CVSim source provenance

Source project: https://physionet.org/content/cvsim/1.0.0/
Version: 1.0.0
Authors credited by source: Thomas Heldt, George Moody, Roger Mark. Implementation by Catherine Dunn and Thomas Heldt, with contributions from Ali Saeed and Brandon Pierquet.

PhysioNet labels the files Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0.
Exact project-specific terms: https://physionet.org/content/cvsim/view-license/1.0.0/

Contains information from CVSim v1.0.0, made available by PhysioNet under the ODC Attribution License.

The ODC-By preamble states that it governs database rights rather than individual contents. The C files do not include an explicit model-level software license grant. This records the upstream designation, without reclassifying the C source as MIT/GPL/Apache or asserting an independent software-license grant. Only unchanged research reference source is retained here; separately bundled Java GUI third-party licenses are not applied to the cardiovascular equations.

Original publication: Heldt T, Mukkamala R, Moody GB, Mark RG. CVSim: An Open-Source Cardiovascular Simulator for Teaching and Research. Open Pacing, Electrophysiol & Ther J. 2010;3:45-54. https://lcp.mit.edu/pdf/HeldtTOPETJ10.pdf
